title: What resolution is the average PC gamer playing at?
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
In a world where GPUs are super expensive but also extremely powerful, I've lost track of what the average person's computer is capable of playing at?

Google says 1080 but even consoles can run 1440 - 4K now.

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: Great, this makes life much easier. No idea why I had it in my mind that in this day and age it was 4k or nothing.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: You should support 1080p, 1440, and 4k, with some post scaling for the rest.

comments.author: Former-Storm-5087
comments.body:
1080 60fps is standard.
On an average pc,  2k 4k  would probably run at 30

comments.author: AnAnnouncer
comments.body:
No, you can't skip on 4K display optimizations!

Steam reports it's 50% for 1080p, 25% for 1440p, and 5% for 2160p. So 1080p is still the top, even if 50% might not be a super precise number for gamers specifically since some people launch Steam on non-gaming devices.

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: No I won't skip the optimizations because that is what I play at. However, it does make life a bit easier knowing that 4K is a minority.

comments.author: meshuggahzen
comments.body:
I play at 5120x2160.  
The games that do support it look amazing, but I know its a very minimal use.

Up to 4K at least would be good.

comments.author: i_dont_wanna_sign_up
comments.body: 1080p is the most bang for your buck unless you absolutely need a giant screen for some reason.

comments.author: AmazingGabriel16
comments.body: 1080p max settings on 200Hz monitor with adaptive sync no frame gen pure native

comments.author: No_Dig_7017
comments.body: I'd say 1080p but check Valve's Hardware Survey

comments.author: Arkenhammer
comments.body:
I generally support resolutions from 800p to 2160p and aspect ratios from 3:2 to 21:9. That catches most of it on Steam. You also need some kind of support for multi-monitor setups.

In terms of performance testing I want the game to play well on a Steam Deck and at 1440p on a 3060.

comments.author: unfamily_friendly
comments.body:
Steam makes surveys on hardware and OS. You should check and then decideI think most people are on 1080p and 16x9 aspect ratio now. Steamdeck is 16x10 and 1280x1080

And don't think about consoles yet. Releasing on consoles will cost you like 5000$
